name: com.gameframex.unity.setting.wechatminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Setting (WeChat Mini Game)
description:
WeChat Mini Game storage backend for GameFrameX Setting. Implements ISettingStorageBackend over the WeChatWASM synchronous storage APIs with typed int / float / string get / set, HasKey and delete operations, and self-registers via SettingStorageBackendFactory during SubsystemRegistration — referencing means registering, no manual setup. One backend per runtime environment (first registration wins); Editor and environments without a channel package fall back to Unity PlayerPrefs. Guarded by asmdef defineConstraints (UNITY_WEBGL + ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME) with Preserve-based IL2CPP stripping protection. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Setting 的微信小游戏存储后端渠道包。基于 WeChatWASM 同步存储 API 实现 ISettingStorageBackend，提供 int / float / string 读写、HasKey 与删除操作，并在 SubsystemRegistration 阶段经 SettingStorageBackendFactory 自注册（引用即注册，无需手动配置）。每个运行环境至多一个后端（首个注册生效），Editor 与未注册渠道的环境回退 Unity PlayerPrefs。asmdef defineConstraints（UNITY_WEBGL + ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME）守护编译，并以 Preserve 防止 IL2CPP 裁剪。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
